cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Raise the Stakes
cards.instruction: Persuade them to accept a larger risk, cost, or commitment so the outcome will feel decisive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's make this chess game decide who cooks all weekend.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We were playing for a biscuit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the biscuit. I'll do the washing-up if you lose; you still cook.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want you ordering three-course meals.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You choose the menu. But whoever loses feeds us until Monday. Agreed?
